'''Zak Quiglee''', who also went by the nickname "'''Squidfella'''", was a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] male who participated in bongo racing on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] shortly after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. With [[Friggy Squig]] and [[Tup Tup Grizbain]]'s support, Quiglee attempted to ban [[Neb Neb Goodrow]] and [[Spleed Nukkels]] from the sport on certain accusations. However, their accusations were overruled.<ref name="Deep Spoilers" />

Quiglee participated in the [[Otoh Gunga Challenge]] where he drove a [[monobubble bongo]]. He was close behind the lead at the beginning of the race, but would end up crashing later during the race. He went missing, leading to the suspension of Goodrow and Nukkels. However, it was part of his plan to keep them racing again. Quiglee stole a [[Military bongo|militia bongo]] and attacked them. The two racers, along with Major [[Fassa (Gungan)|Fassa]], used [[Boss Nass' racing bongo]] to disable his craft.<ref name="Deep Spoilers" />

In turn, Quiglee was suspended and sent to an off-site clinic for counseling.<ref name="Deep Spoilers" />
